The assistant uses %1$s, a language model that runs on this phone. It can summarise your records and answer questions about them. Your records stay on this phone.
What the assistant does not do
The assistant does not give medical advice and does not work out insulin doses. Your doses always come from the check-in, which follows your sliding scale.

Vibrate when I press a button

This app works out insulin doses from the sliding scale that you entered from your doctor’s order. It does not give medical advice. Please speak with your doctor or diabetes educator if you have questions about your insulin.

Your records are stored only on this phone. To keep them safe if you lose or replace your phone, please use Settings › Backup and restore. You can share them with your doctor from Settings › Export for your doctor. The app uses the internet only to download the assistant model and the natural voices.
The advice shown for low and high readings is general information. Please ask your doctor or diabetes educator what you should do, and follow their advice if it is different.

This app is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. The icons are Material Symbols from Google, used under the Apache License 2.0. The optional natural voices use Kokoro-82M and sherpa-onnx, both under the Apache License 2.0, and eSpeak NG data under the GNU General Public License, version 3.
